purpose: Bounded descriptive feasibility pilot for an ERBB3 epithelial-function candidate; not independent biological validation or exact paper reproduction
sample_mapping: GSM prefix to SOFT sample; workbook count column must match deposited Library name
unit: deposited library; donor/preparation independence and replicate pairing unresolved
metadata_conflicts: Human epithelial titles and GRCh38 processing conflict with mouse husbandry/restraint protocol fields; retain conflict without inventing a correction
GEO cytokine label differs from paper growth-factor EGF/EREG/NRG1 wording; preserve Cyto as a source label, with interpretation conditional
Methods mention FPKM while workbook columns and supplemental description say Read_Count; assess numeric type and retain deposited-value provenance
controls: Consi in the same source context; NoIR control for descriptive context only
contrasts: For each target and context, mean log2(normalized abundance + 1) in two target libraries minus mean of two context-matched control libraries
context_comparison: Difference of knockdown contrasts between IR and Cyto; no uninjured knockdown exists, so cannot estimate an injury-versus-baseline interaction
primary_normalization: CPM over all nonblank, nonnegative numeric deposited count rows; duplicate gene symbols summed before normalization
sensitivity_normalization: Positive-count median-ratio size factors across all libraries, scaled to the median library total, then CPM; genes need at least seven positive libraries
panel_rule: Equal-weight mean of fixed log2(CPM+1) genes, require all symbols present; show each gene and coverage, do not relabel as a complete pathway
detection_description: CPM >= 1, reported per gene and library, never used to select a favourable contrast
inference: No biological p-values, confidence intervals, gene-DE claims, fate, stemness, secretion, clinical causality or new global RQ ID
outputs: Immutable runs/E5_external_v1 with selected source counts, library QC, gene and panel contrasts, normalization sensitivity and run hashes; optional descriptive figure separate from original atlas
